culture.textEn: Korean weather forecasts name the sky by how much of it clouds cover: {ko:맑음} (clear) up to half, {ko:구름많음} (mostly cloudy) six to eight tenths, and {ko:흐림} (cloudy) nine or ten tenths.

sources.title: 예보용어해설
sources.quoteOrLocator: 하늘 상태 표현: ‘하늘상태 표현을 구름량(운량)으로 알려주는 표입니다.’ 맑음 ‘구름이 0~5할의 상태’ / 구름많음 ‘구름이 6~8할의 상태’ / 흐림 ‘구름이 9~10할의 상태’

sources.title: 예보용어해설 (주요업무 > 예보업무)
sources.quoteOrLocator: ‘예보용어는 날씨해설, 기상정보, 예보통보문 등 예보를 전달하는 문서와 영상에 사용되는 언어’ 하늘 상태 표현: 맑음 ‘구름이 0~5할의 상태’ / 구름많음 ‘구름이 6~8할의 상태’ / 흐림 ‘구름이 9~10할의 상태’

verification.notes:
pass 1 (author sourcing, CM-41 S6, 2026-10-30): both Korea Meteorological Administration pages fetched 2026-10-30, HTTP 200. Each gives the sky-state table of the forecast terms: 맑음 0~5할, 구름많음 6~8할, 흐림 9~10할 of the sky covered by cloud; the kma.go.kr page says the terms are the words of forecast documents and broadcasts. 'up to half' = 0~5할; 'six to eight tenths' = 6~8할; 'nine or ten tenths' = 9~10할. Used in: q1 (the card's 맑음, the r3 distractor 흐림) and the q1 Did you know? tip.
pass 2 (MAR culture and facts, 2026-10-30): both pages re-read; each quoteOrLocator found word for word. The note names the institution as it was on the access date (기상청, Korea Meteorological Administration). It claims no more than the table: no rule about icons, apps or rain, and 구름많음 is shown only in the note, never asked. No copied English wording. Outcome: pass, no change.
pass 3 (MAR third pass, 2026-10-30): the q1 card, Hoya lines and captions make no claim beyond this note (the card is drawn and generic, no weather service, place or brand). Outcome: pass, no change.

culture.textEn: The Korea National Park Service shows a weather forecast for its national parks, with data from the Korea Meteorological Administration, whose weather site can also find a park or a well-known mountain by name.

sources.title: 국립공원 날씨
sources.quoteOrLocator: 국립공원탐방 > 안전한 탐방 > 국립공원 날씨: ‘기상예보 공원별 정보’ (가야산 … 한려해상) ‘자료제공 :’ [기상청 로고] ‘동네예보를 시간별로 날씨, 기온, 강수확률, 최저/최고기온 을 나타낸 도표입니다.’

sources.title: 예보용어해설 (도움말: 현재위치 확인 및 지역검색 방법)
sources.quoteOrLocator: ‘육상지역 검색은 지역의 읍면동지역 뿐만 아니라 주요건물, 유명산, 공원 등 지명을 검색창에 입력하여 조회된 검색결과를 선택하여 확인할 수 있습니다.’

verification.notes:
pass 1 (author sourcing, CM-41 S6, 2026-10-30): the Korea National Park Service page 국립공원 날씨 (fetched 2026-10-30, HTTP 200 with a browser user agent) lists a forecast by park (공원별 정보, from 가야산 to 한려해상) and credits its data (자료제공) to the Korea Meteorological Administration: the credit is the KMA logo, whose alt text is 기상청 로고 and whose link is kma.go.kr. The KMA weather site's help text, on the 날씨누리 page fetched the same day, says a land search finds places by name, 유명산 and 공원 included. 'a forecast for its national parks' = 공원별 정보 (23 parks listed; Hallasan is not among them, so the note says 'its national parks', not 'each'); 'with data from' = 자료제공; 'a park or a well-known mountain by name' = 유명산, 공원 등 지명. Used in: the q2 Did you know? tip.
pass 2 (MAR culture and facts, 2026-10-30): both pages re-read; the quotes match. Both institutions are named as on the access date (국립공원공단; 기상청). The note makes no claim about accuracy, apps or the number of parks. Outcome: pass, no change.
pass 3 (MAR third pass, 2026-10-30): no Hoya line or caption of q2 claims anything about real signs or services. Outcome: pass, no change.

culture.textEn: The Korea National Park Service gives guide maps of the national parks, and for most parks a grade map, where the colour of a trail shows how hard it is, in five grades from very easy to very hard.

sources.title: 국립공원 지도
sources.quoteOrLocator: 국립공원탐방 > 국립공원 지도: ‘북한산국립공원 안내지도 PDF JPG 등급지도 PDF JPG … 지리산국립공원 안내지도 PDF JPG 등급지도 PDF JPG … 한라산국립공원 안내지도 PDF JPG’ (23 parks with a 안내지도; 22 of them with a 등급지도)

sources.title: 체력 맞춰 사고 없이! 가을로 물든 북한산 '안전' 산행
sources.quoteOrLocator: ‘국립공원공단 누리집에서 '국립공원탐방 → 국립공원 지도'로 들어간 뒤, 북한산국립공원의 '등급지도'를 선택하면 된다.’ ‘이 선의 색깔은 탐방로의 난이도를 나타내는 역할이었다. 탐방로는 '매우 쉬움·쉬움·보통·어려움·매우 어려움'의 다섯 등급으로 나뉘어 있었다.’

verification.notes:
pass 1 (author sourcing, CM-41 S6, 2026-10-30): the Korea National Park Service page 국립공원 지도 (fetched 2026-10-30, HTTP 200 with a browser user agent) offers a 안내지도 (guide map) for 23 national parks and a 등급지도 (grade map) for 22 of them (Hallasan has a guide map only), so the note says 'for most parks', not 'each'. The korea.kr page (the government's policy briefing site, fetched the same day) follows that menu to the Bukhansan grade map and says the line colour shows a trail's difficulty in five grades, 매우 쉬움 to 매우 어려움. Used in: the q3 Did you know? tip.
pass 2 (MAR culture and facts, 2026-10-30): both pages re-read; each quote found. The colours themselves and the count of parks stay out of learner copy, because they can change; the grades are given as 'very easy to very hard'. The institution is named as on the access date (국립공원공단). Outcome: pass, no change.
pass 3 (MAR third pass, 2026-10-30): the q3 map is drawn and generic (no park, place or organiser named) and the q3 lines make no claim about real maps. Outcome: pass, no change.

notes: Volume 2 MAR (row CM-41 S6, F-CURR-002 9.2, 2026-10-30; passes: author, language, culture and facts, learning design, reviser, third pass). No native-speaker or expert review is claimed; language: native-reviewed is the schema's name for the signed-off language gate.

Language pass: spelling, spacing, particles and the polite 해요체 checked line by line (예요 after a vowel, 이에요 after a final: 호수예요, 안내소예요, 매점이에요, 주차장이에요); every romanization is the F-CNT-002 converter's (checkRomanization). 등산로 was dropped for 산길: the converter gives deungsallo where the dictionary pronunciation needs checking, so no word with an unverified sound change ships.

Language pass (cont.): Applied: ko q1 r1 asks 하루 뒤에는 (no echo of the key 내일), ko q3 reward line any-age (즐거운 시간 보내요), es q3 r1 says auto, es tú throughout; no tile gloss gives a value gap away by grammar (es tiles of q2 c2 carry their article).

Culture and facts pass: n1 (sky words 맑음, 구름많음, 흐림 by cloud cover) on two Korea Meteorological Administration pages; n2 (the park forecast with KMA data, and the KMA site's place search) on the Korea National Park Service and KMA pages; n3 (guide and grade maps, five grades) on the Korea National Park Service page and korea.kr.

Culture and facts pass (cont.): Applied: n2 says 'its national parks' and n3 'for most parks', since Hallasan is not in the KNPS forecast list and has no grade map. The forecast card, the trail sign and the park map are drawn and generic: no park, place, weather service, shop or brand; numbers are practice values; no line claims anything about real signs, maps or services; suits any age.

Learning design pass: 3 quests; new items per quest 5, 6 and 5 (at most 8); Practice and Check items from earlier quests 4 of 6, 3 of 6 and 3 of 6 (lesson-recycle at least 30 in 100); Checks Type Hangul (Dictation of 비 and 눈), Cloze Pick (value gaps on the quest's own trail sign) and Realia Read (the park map), one of each, none above 40 in 100 of the stage's Volume 2 Checks;

Learning design pass (cont.): each Check reads a meaning or produces and asks what Practice did not (q2 c1 the spring's minutes, c2 the place forty minutes away; q3 c1 the information center's side, c2 the shop by what it sells). Triples RR/CP/TH, RR/TH/CP, RR/TR/RR differ from Volume 1's (RR/TH/RR, RR/TR/TH, RR/TH/RR) and from each other.

Learning design pass (cont.): Device voice: 이십 분, 삼십 분, 사십 분 are said with a tense ㅂ ([이십뿐]), 약수터 [약쑤터] and 맑음 [말금] change in speech, so none is asked in Dictation; the Dictation targets 비 and 눈 have no sound change and one spelling each, and play their Type Hangul see fallback while game.type-hangul-hear is at pct 0.
Reviser: applied the fixes above (the 등산로 swap, the n2 and n3 scope words, the ko and es wording). Third pass: no change.
